rules: No directory enumeration; only exact target package queries.
Entry maps are AssetRegistry-only; never load World assets.
Import source filesystem metadata is limited to project art_source.
Source paths/import metadata are not licence evidence; licence state remains the input ledger value.
Failed reads keep NOT_READ and null counts; no empty-list fallback.
No Runtime,Fonts,Saved/user files,network downloads or hash calculations.
